title.narrative: DRK - Danish Red Cross - Resilience, Health and Rights 2021-2025 - NGO call Horn of Africa - Kenya

description.narrative: The project "Resilience, Health, and Rights: Sustainable Solutions and Support to Vulnerable Displaced and Host Communities in Northern Kenya" seeks to contribute to build longer-term resillience in marginalised areas, provide access to services, in particular primary health including protection from SGBV and MHPSS services, and promote rights for those affected by displacement whose vulnerabilities have been exacerbated by COVID-19.
